subject.title: Cron jobs stall during AI model calls (model_call:stream_progress never completes)

question: Should this issue remain the canonical tracker for cron wake-now result semantics, or should maintainers split that remaining behavior into a focused issue now that the stream-stall subset is fixed on main?
rationale: The remaining bug is narrower than the original title, and changing cron.wake from enqueue-only success to outcome-aware reporting affects tool and Gateway RPC semantics.

options.title: Split Wake-Now
options.body: Create or designate a focused cron wake-now contract issue, link this issue, and close this issue only after the focused tracker exists or the fix lands.

options.title: Keep This Canonical
options.body: Retitle or rescope this issue around cron wake-now result reporting and use it as the repair target.

options.title: Document Enqueue-Only
options.body: Treat cron.wake mode now as enqueue-only success and document that heartbeat failures are reported separately.

recommendation.title: Split Wake-Now
recommendation.body: Create or designate a focused cron wake-now contract issue, link this issue, and close this issue only after the focused tracker exists or the fix lands.

likelyOwner.reason: They recently landed the related run-lifecycle stack and identified the remaining wake contract gap in the issue discussion.
